tools.name: crypto_ticker
tools.description: Spot USD price for a crypto ticker or CoinGecko id from public price feeds, cached 60 s. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: erc20_balance
tools.description: Raw and formatted ERC-20 balanceOf for an address on Base, with decimals read from the token. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: fx_spot_price_oracle
tools.description: Reference fiat and stablecoin conversion rate from a static table, not a live feed. Returns rate and inverse; result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: block_info
tools.description: Base block header: number, timestamp, transaction count and base fee for the latest or a given block. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: tx_activity
tools.description: Outbound transaction count (nonce) and contract-or-EOA check for an address on Base. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: token_contract_risk
tools.description: Deterministic Base contract facts: ERC-20 metadata, proxy slots, owner(), privileged-function selectors and flags. Not a safety verdict. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: clean_markdown_scraper
tools.description: Fetch a public web page by URL (or take your HTML) and return Markdown plus headings. No JavaScript rendering. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: context_distill
tools.description: Deterministic text digest: word count, top-5 most frequent meaningful words (stop words excluded), first sentence, and a keccak-256 content hash. Pure function — no external calls, no ML.

tools.name: instant_json_schema_verifier
tools.description: Validate JSON data payloads against schema definitions. Preflighted for agent tool call pipelines.

tools.name: balance_check
tools.description: Native ETH and one ERC-20 balance (default USDC) for an address on Base, raw and formatted. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: calculate_fx_savings
tools.description: Arithmetic comparison of a USDC settlement against comparator percentages YOU supply (bank_fee_pct, custodial_fee_pct) across 14 global fiat currencies. The comparators are assumptions, not measurements of any bank or provider; no protocol fee is deducted on this rail.

tools.name: iban_check
tools.description: Validate IBAN structure and MOD-97 checksum. Does not establish account ownership, beneficiary identity or absence of fraud.

tools.name: lei_check
tools.description: Validate a 20-character LEI and MOD-97 check digits. No registry lookup, active-registration check or legal-entity identity verification.

tools.name: vat_mod97_check
tools.description: Check the supported Belgian VAT format and MOD-97 checksum. BE only; not VIES, other EU VAT formats, registration status or tax compliance.

tools.name: swift_bic_check
tools.description: Check SWIFT/BIC structure and country code. Does not establish bank existence, active routing or beneficiary identity.

tools.name: batch_validate
tools.description: Run up to 50 supported {tool, value} checks in one request. Each result states its scope. Compare the current batch quote with individual quotes; savings depend on batch size.

tools.name: vendor_onboarding_pack
tools.description: Check supplied IBAN, LEI, Belgian VAT and UK company-number fields in one result. Structural checks only; no ownership, registry or fraud clearance.

tools.name: india_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: GSTIN + PAN + UPI VPA + IFSC for an Indian counterparty. Four deterministic structural checks, each stating its own scope. Built for cross-border procurement where the buyer is an agent that cannot open an INR account.

tools.name: pre_disbursement_guard
tools.description: Evaluate supplied identifiers, domain-age evidence and mismatch signals. Requires a preceding receipt hash. An advisory result is not verified identity, fraud clearance or authorization to release funds.

tools.name: gstin_check
tools.description: Validate an Indian GSTIN by structure (2-digit state code + PAN + entity code + 'Z') and its mod-36 cross-sum checksum.

tools.name: ifsc_check
tools.description: Check the 11-character Indian IFSC format, including its fifth-character zero. No bank-branch registry lookup or account verification.

tools.name: sanctions_address_screen
tools.description: Exact EVM-address comparison against the identified address snapshot and existing operator block policy. findings.detail: Description of "pre_disbursement_guard" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
